draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.00, the 141st-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 23rd of 36 at CB. He lasted until pick 176, well after his grade rank (141st): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the New York Jets. 29 career games and 5 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 2 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: missed tackle rate 3.6% (92nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 cornerback who played: 21.9% season snap share against a median of 27.8%, below the norm.
